description: This Java source file defines the ShipmentEvents class, which contains static methods for handling shipment-related web events, such as viewing shipment package route segment label images and checking/forcing shipment receipt status within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ShipmentEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods for handling shipment-related web events in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: viewShipmentPackageRouteSegLabelImage
methods.description: Streams the label image for a shipment package route segment to the browser, handling errors if the image is missing or cannot be written.

methods.name: checkForceShipmentReceived
methods.description: Checks if a shipment should be marked as received based on request parameters and updates its status accordingly.
